summary: The proposed change improves the default logging format by including the module name, which enhances log readability. However, it introduces a behavioral regression risk by changing the default format without providing an option to revert to the old format.

issues.description: Changing the default logging format may break existing configurations and scripts that rely on the current format. There should be a mechanism to allow users to specify their preferred logging format.
The change in the default logging format should be documented in the release notes and possibly in the configuration documentation to inform users about the new default.
